verdict.rationale: Extracted body text from sos.wa.gov/corporations-charities and dor.wa.gov guidance pages (e.g., the Initial Report fee note, the 'Pause. Check the Cause' text, and the same-day counter fee quote) suggests these public pages serve readable HTML to a keyless fetch. The only probe found a JS-only shell, but it was the transactional secure.dor.wa.gov tax portal, not the SOS guidance surface. Missing for 10: a direct probe confirming HTTP 200 server-rendered HTML for sos.wa.gov guidance pages with an identified agent user agent, explicit evidence of no bot wall or CAPTCHA, and independent hands-on corroboration.
